exploit_name: TWAP EMA misweighting due to incorrect destructuring of return values
description: Incorrect destructuring of getEMAs() return values. Expected order is (spotEMA, fastEMA, slowEMA, eonsEMA) but code treats it as (eonsEMA, slowEMA, fastEMA), anchoring TWAP to slow EMA instead of fast.
root_cause: Incorrect destructuring of getEMAs() return values. Expected order is (spotEMA, fastEMA, slowEMA, eonsEMA) but code treats it as (eonsEMA, slowEMA, fastEMA), anchoring TWAP to slow EMA instead of fast.
fix_description: Destructure in correct order: (, int256 fastEMA, int256 slowEMA, int256 eonsEMA, ).
notes: Insolvent accounts dodge liquidation as unhealthy positions appear solvent at stale TWAP ticks.
